entities.summary: Anna Mar, who used the pseudonym Printsessa Gryoza, was a Russian screenwriter, playwright, novelist, and journalist. She was one of the most prolific screenwriters of early Russian cinema and 13 films were made from her scripts between 1914 and 1918.
